Q: My Ubuntu machine doesn't start with error: "possible ucsi driver bug" A:

I'll answer my own question. It turns out my disk was full. The way to fix it was to click Ctrl + Alt + F2, which opened the terminal. Then I cleared some space on my disk and rebooted and everything went back to work as expected.

Q: How do I pass a function with variable as an argument A:

This question should have been posted as normal Q/A post, because it has a clear answer.

Regarding the actual issue: this looks like a duplicate of: Is it possible to use std::sort with a sort function that takes extra arguments?.

Summary:
Instead of a function for the comparator you can use a class with operator() (usually called a functor). This class can have members to control the comparison.
This is shown in one of the answers of the proposed duplicate.
Another option is to use a lambda with a capture of selector.
